name: Git Tracker
author: Matt Barr
description: Every local git repo in one panel, found automatically: what needs committing, pushing or pulling, with commit, push, pull and merge buttons. Works with any git host: GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, Gitea, self-hosted.

barWidget.description: Finds the git repos in your folders and shows which need a commit, push or pull. Commit, push, pull and merge from the panel; open a repo, its branch, a new pull request or the last commit on its host; add a remote to a local-only repo; open it in a terminal or in lazygit. Right-click rescans, middle-click checks remotes.

schema.label: How many folders deep to look
Check remotes for new commits in the background (uses the network)
Remote whose site links open (when a repo has several)
Web host overrides, comma separated: ssh-host=web-host and/or a site type (github, gitlab, gitea, forgejo, bitbucket), e.g. git.corp=gitlab.corp.com gitlab
Remote for local-only repos, {name} is the folder name, e.g. git@codeberg.org:you/{name}.git
